import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/test_3.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source CSV, extract the 'video' column, and append to dfs list
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Extract only the 'video' column
        video_col = df[['video']]
        dfs.append(video_col)

    # Concatenate all video columns vertically
    combined_videos = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Drop duplicates to match the target examples (unique videos only)
    unique_videos = combined_videos.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Sort videos to have a consistent order (optional)
    unique_videos = unique_videos.sort_values(by='video').reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    unique_videos.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
